description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80.  A black solid line with circular markers, representing “Base”, begins at approximately (1, 60) and increases to approximately (1000, 66). A light-brown dashed line with diamond markers, representing “MEND”, starts at approximately (1, 64) and increases to approximately (1000, 73). A blue solid line with triangular markers, representing “FT”, begins at approximately (1, 62) and increases to approximately (1000, 70). A pink solid line with square markers, representing “MEMIT”, starts at approximately (1, 68) and increases to approximately (1000, 75). A red solid line with triangular markers, representing “IKE”, begins at approximately (1, 64) and declines to approximately (1000, 68). A green solid line with square markers, representing “MEMIT”, starts at approximately (1, 72) and remains relatively constant at approximately (1000, 76).
